:::{#exm-profile-loglik}
#### Profile log-likelihood of a Gaussian variance

In the Gaussian model, $\hmean = \bar x$ maximizes $\llik$ over $\mean$
for every value of $\varpar$ ([Gaussian MLEs](#sec-gaussian-mle)),
so the profile log-likelihood of $\varpar$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}
\llik_p(\varpar)
&= \llik(\bar x, \varpar)
&& \text{(definition of the profile log-likelihood)}\\
&= -\frac{n}{2}\logf{2\pi} - \frac{n}{2}\logf{\varpar}
 - \frac{1}{2\varpar}\sumin (\rvar_\iobs - \bar x)^2
&& \text{(Gaussian log-likelihood at $\mean = \bar x$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
